static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy; never experienced equally strong fear at work before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, markedly anxious and worried mood; tending toward catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future, negating the positive, and overgeneralization; skeptical attitude toward change but willing to try, fair cooperativeness; negative tone and strong defensiveness when discussing supervisor evaluations

basic_info.main_problem: I recently started a new job, but I constantly feel my boss will dislike me; this belief appeared soon after onboarding and brings significant stress.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear of being disliked by my boss is affecting my work performance and overall well-being, so I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: The client attributes current fear to past bad experiences with authority figures ('I have met some terrible bosses before'). Although she reports never experiencing equally intense fear at work before, sensitivity to authority / supervisor evaluation formed from it: criticism or constructive feedback is more easily read as total negation of ability and worth, quickly triggering worries about being disliked and fired.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent.
If others (especially supervisors) do not like me, I will be negated and abandoned.

special_situations.event: After starting the job, received constructive feedback from the supervisor over a small mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake, it means I am incompetent, they will regret hiring me and eventually let me go.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive self-monitoring, trying to avoid further mistakes; avoiding contact with the boss to lower the chance of criticism.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am very incompetent, hiring me was a mistake, I will be fired.

special_situations.event: Before and after work each day when alone, rehearsing interacting with the supervisor and worrying about upcoming exchanges
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the boss has no sustained positive feedback, it means they are dissatisfied or dislike me; negative outcomes will happen sooner or later.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Thinking over details repeatedly, intensifying worry in order to 'be prepared'; reducing communication with the supervisor and colleagues.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He / she will sooner or later hate me; something will definitely go wrong next.

special_situations.event: After completing work, receives positive recognition from supervisors or colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' affirmation is just politeness, not real evaluation; once I err, nothing positive counts.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive feedback, only focusing on own inadequacy and possible mistakes.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These compliments do not count, they are just being polite.

special_situations.event: Needs face-to-face communication with the boss or to arrange a report
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: With close contact, the boss will discover my inadequacy and become even more dissatisfied, with terrible consequences.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids the supervisor, delays communication, reduces exposure.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If we meet, they will pick faults with me, and things will get worse and worse.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted by superiors, to have a stable and secure work relationship.
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected, humiliated, or abandoned by authority, ultimately losing position and a sense of value.
defense_goal: Keeping distance from the boss to avoid being negated and hurt
Preventing mistakes and lowering risk through excessive self-monitoring and self-criticism

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a subordinate who may fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A picky boss / authority who disappoints easily and may negate people at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor gives affirmation or proposes steps and suggestions for change
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously seeing others' affirmation as 'just politeness', change as 'likely futile', similar to past anticipation of being negated by authority replaying in the counseling relationship (transference).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a hesitant, reserved tone, frequently using words like 'but / maybe / I am not sure', slowing speech, reducing self-disclosure, avoiding clear commitments.

manifestations: At work, distances from colleagues out of fear of being disliked by the boss, reducing interaction
Although having friends and family to talk to, not yet sharing specific fears, choosing to bear it alone
Focusing attention on own inadequacy and others' possible negative evaluations, forming an inner sense of isolation
outcomes: Decline in work performance and lowered self-efficacy

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly expressing in sessions 'I can try, but it may be useless', staying reserved about change
Excessively focusing on whether I will make mistakes, expressing cautiously and avoiding commitments

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interprets the supervisor's positive feedback as 'just being polite' rather than genuine recognition
Tending in counseling to attribute inner insecurity to others not liking her

exception_events.target_problem: When interacting with the supervisor or after completing tasks, the client usually thinks the boss dislikes her, and therefore avoids communication, worrying repeatedly.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After completing some tasks she received the boss's affirmation or recognition, with objectively positive feedback appearing, different from her anticipation of 'inevitably being disliked'.
exception_events.reason: Different situation / support: task completion quality was high with concrete affirmation, objective evidence briefly supporting her sense of competence.

positive_force: Has some competence and has received the boss's affirmation
Able to notice own negative thinking patterns and willing to try changing
Having a certain social support system (friends and family to communicate with)
negative_force: Significant cognitive distortions like catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future, negating the positive, and overgeneralization
Negative expectations of authority and the impact of past bad experiences
Avoids the boss and colleagues, forming a negative maintenance cycle
Sleep and diet affected, further lowering mood and work state
Skeptical attitude toward change, low self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding contact and communication with the boss
antecedent: Making mistakes at work or receiving constructive feedback
Situations requiring arranging a report or face-to-face communication with a supervisor
Before and after commuting, repeatedly worries about upcoming interactions
target_behavior.core_reason: Influenced by past negative authority experiences, combined with cognitive distortions of catastrophizing, mind reading, and predicting the future, equating feedback with total negation and imminent dismissal.
target_behavior.function: Escaping criticism / negation to temporarily lower anxiety and discomfort.
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal distancing, worsened anxiety, decline in work performance, further reinforcing the belief of 'being disliked'.

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry and disturbed physiological functioning (sleep and eating)
antecedent: Repeatedly thinking about the boss's evaluation of her when alone
Recalls mistakes at work or upcoming evaluations/feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Trying to predict and control the future through worry and rumination, to ease anxiety from uncertainty (predicting the future, emotional reasoning).
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and safety (a failed attempt at self-soothing).
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental exhaustion, decreased emotional tolerance, impaired attention, further affecting work and socializing.
